newsitem.title: FRANCE: RUGBY UNION-FOUROUX RETURNS TO UNION CODE.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-FOUROUX RETURNS TO UNION CODE.

text.p: Former France captain and coach Jacques Fouroux has returned to the union code after a two-year interlude in rugby league.

Fouroux, until recently chairman of the French Rugby League, was voted unanimously as president of his home town second division club Auch on Monday night by fellow members of the club's new board of directors.
Financially stricken Auch threw out a majority of the old board at the beginning of October.
The "Little Corporal" committed himself to "putting the club's finances back on their feet in two years and returning it to its rightful place as leading club in the Armagnac-Bigorre (region)".

Fouroux resigned as France coach in 1990 at the end of a decade in charge during which the Tricolores won the Five Nations championship six times, including two grand slams and reached the final of the inaugural World Cup in 1987.
